context: A retired theater veteran reminisces with a uni student
purpose: Teach: ディスカッション/ネイティブ/コミュニティー/劇団/騎士/奮闘/ハッキリ/ブルース

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃はね、小さな劇団に入って、毎日奮闘してたんだよ。
lines.en: When I was young, I joined a small theater troupe and struggled every day.
lines.style: Warm reminiscing tone, slow nostalgic pacing throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: へえ、すごいですね。どんな役をやってたんですか?
lines.en: Wow, that's amazing. What kind of roles did you play?
lines.style: Curious student tone, polite and engaged delivery

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 最初は西洋風の芝居で、騎士の役をやらされてさ。今思うと笑えるよ。
lines.en: At first I was made to play a knight in a Western-style play. Looking back it's funny.
lines.style: Self-deprecating chuckle, fond recollection with soft laugh

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 稽古の後はみんなで集まって、ディスカッションとかしてたんですか?
lines.en: After rehearsals, did everyone gather and have discussions and such?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, leaning forward with bright energy

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: もちろん。台本についてハッキリ意見を言い合うのが当たり前でね。
lines.en: Of course. It was normal to clearly share opinions about the script.
lines.style: Firm proud tone, hands gesturing slightly while speaking

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いいですね、そういうコミュニティーって今あんまりない気がします。
lines.en: That sounds great. I feel like that kind of community doesn't really exist now.
lines.style: Wistful student observation, soft sighing tone throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 終演後はね、近くのバーでブルースを聴きながら一杯やるのが楽しみでさ。
lines.en: After shows, listening to blues at a nearby bar over a drink was my joy.
lines.style: Dreamy nostalgic delivery, eyes drifting upward in memory

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ネイティブの英語の曲ですか?かっこいいなあ、その時代。
lines.en: Songs by native English speakers? That era sounds so cool.
lines.style: Impressed youthful admiration, slightly envious wistful sigh

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 君もさ、何でもいいから本気で打ち込めるもの、見つけるといいよ。
lines.en: You too, find something you can throw yourself into wholeheartedly.
lines.style: Gentle mentor advice, warm closing tone of encouragement
